svg.desc: Complete local Chen views for this domain. Every gray reference repeats the entity named on its numbered sheet. Relationships introduce FK columns during mapping; all stored scalar attributes and selected keys are shown. See relational-schema.md for the derivation, conditional participation and full relational constraints.
